content:
Two small PRs in analysis / measure theory, ready for review:

  • #43904 feat(MeasureTheory/Constructions/HaarToSphere): polar coordinates for lintegral
    (+84 lines, one file). Measure.measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd is currently
    exposed only through radial corollaries (integral_fun_norm_addHaar etc.). This adds the
    general lintegral form for an arbitrary measurable f : E → ℝ≥0∞, on the whole space and
    on a ball. CI is green.

  • #43905 feat(Analysis/FunctionalSpaces): prove Morrey's inequality (depends on #43904).
    The supercritical companion of SobolevInequality.lean: for finrank ℝ E < p, a C¹
    function satisfies the Hölder estimate
    ‖u x - u z‖ₑ ≤ C * ‖x - z‖ₑ ^ (1 - n/p) * eLpNorm (fderiv ℝ u) p μ, and a function
    supported in a bounded set satisfies eLpNorm u ⊤ μ ≤ C' * eLpNorm (fderiv ℝ u) p μ.
    Constants are explicit and homogeneous in μ. Proof: polar coordinates, FTC along rays,
    Hölder against the Riesz kernel, comparison of averages over two balls and their
    common sub-ball (Evans §5.6.2, Lieb–Loss §8.4). The target space is not assumed complete.
    Build and lint-style are green; the full linter run is still in progress.

Context: this is the W^{1,p} ↪ L^∞ embedding that a Floer-homology formalization I am
working on uses repeatedly; it is stated, like the GNS file, for compactly supported C¹
functions, so it does not depend on the ongoing Sobolev-space design (#32305).

Disclosure: the proofs were developed with an LLM (Claude Code) and then checked and
edited by me; I can justify every step. I do not have triage rights, so could someone add
LLM-generated and t-measure-probability / t-analysis to the two PRs? Thanks!
